main_text.l: ex Augustini commentariis, olim le-ctum, ἐξασίλευσεν
ἀπὸ ξύλου : Dominus regnavit à ligno. Potuit dicere, ex Ter-
tulliano & Cyprian quoque : qui
quantò Augustino anteriores, tantò
ad rem magis hîc eorum testimonium.
De his autem verbis, ἀπὸ ξύλου, dudum
quaesivere tum alii, tum Nicolaus Ful-
lerus Anglus, in Miscellaneis suis, in-
tegro capite ; & in tantâ similium assu-
mentorum, integrorum etiam aliquan-
do verficulorum, copiâ, quantam tum
Fullerus, tum alii plures observârunt,
poterat sufficere, quòd vir ille doctis-
si-mus & acutissimus super eo commen-
tatus est. Doctissimus Junius in suis ad
Tertullianum Notis conjiciebat, fieri
posse, ut lippiens aliquis pro ἐξασίλευ-
σεν, legerit ἐξ ξύλου. Ego potiùs dicerem
ineptulum aliquem verbum
βασιλεὺν alludere voluisse, quasi esset βασιλεύειν,
aut ex eâdem, quâ ξυλεύειν seu
ξυλέ-ωαι, origine. Permutari sanè interdum
iftas literas, ut in ἀνάξυεις pro
ἀνάσυ-εις, &c. notat Eustathius alicubi : nec
magnum in Scripturâ discrimen. Sed
quid Chifletius? A vulgari ac tritâ ver-
sione, quam hodierna exhibent exem-
plaria,

page.notes: Marginal handwriting in the right margin ("/ 2", "6") is not printed and is omitted. Greek transcribed as legible; several Greek words are uncertain in the scan (e.g. the verb forms after "pro" and "βασιλεὺν"), and should be checked against the original. The printed signature "I 3" at the foot is a gathering mark.
